fields.System.Title: INT-504 — Ledger-vs-balance drift
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want a standing report of any balance the ledger cannot explain, so
that the system's core promise being broken is visible immediately.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the nightly check from
  • [INV-801](../INV/INV-801-nightly-ledger-balance-check.md), then its findings are surfaced
  • as a report with product, location, expected, actual, and difference.
  • - Given any drift, then it is classified critical and pages a person — not
  • informational.
  • - Given drift, then the report does not correct it.
  • - Given the report, then it also compares WMS on-hand against ERP on-hand per product
  • and lists differences above a threshold.
  • - Given a clean run, then the fact that the check ran and passed is recorded — silence
  • must not be mistaken for success.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, stock_movement, reconciliation results |
| Risks | Balance written without a movement ([doc 09 §2.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); WMS/ERP drift found at year end ([doc 08 §6](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
